about: Curated jeepney routes for Calamba bound trips. Flow, stops and boarding points come from Drei's local knowledge (Oct 21, 2026). Paths are road geometry from OSRM (OpenStreetMap) through the route's known stops, simplified to about 6 m; they are estimates of the jeepney's road, not GPS traces. Polylines use the Google encoded polyline format, precision 5, lat/lng, ordered from 'from' to 'to'. Fares come from js/fare-calc.js (LTFRB Region IV-A jeepney guide).

crossing-grand-terminal.name: Crossing Grand Terminal
crossing-grand-terminal.note: West side of National Highway 1, north of the Crossing triangle (Google plus code 6543+FR). First drop-off of jeeps coming into Calamba.

sm-calamba-west.name: SM Calamba (Cinema side)
sm-calamba-west.note: Driveway on SM City Calamba's west side (SM City Calamba Bypass Road), by SM Cinema and Starbucks. Jeeps drop passengers here for SM; the Calamba-Tagaytay jeep terminal is here too (Google plus code 6533+8V4).

sm-transport-terminal.name: SM Transport Terminal
sm-transport-terminal.note: East side of SM City Calamba, Inner Road (Google plus code 6534+3P). Jeeps to Halang load here.

transfers.via_tl: Dumaan sa loob ng SM City Calamba

routes.name: Sta. Rosa – Calamba
routes.notes: Comes south on National Highway 1 through Cabuyao. Stops at Crossing Grand Terminal, then turns into SM's west driveway and drops passengers by SM Cinema. Board or get off anywhere along the highway.

routes.name: Los Baños (UPLB) – Calamba
routes.notes: Comes on the National Highway through Halang, goes to Crossing Grand Terminal first, then loops back to SM Calamba (Cinema side). Going to Los Baños it passes Halang, so it also serves Halang.

routes.name: SM Calamba – Halang
routes.notes: Loads at SM Transport Terminal. Where it ends past Halang is not recorded yet; the path stops at Halang.

routes.name: Calamba – Tagaytay
routes.notes: Loads at the Calamba-Tagaytay terminal by SM Cinema and passes Real. Past Real the path follows Calamba-Tagaytay Road as OpenStreetMap routes it (rough near the SLEX interchange).

routes.name: Calamba – Tanauan
routes.notes: Passes Real on the way to Tanauan. Boarding point at SM assumed to be the same west-side terminal (to confirm). The path ends on Maharlika Highway past Turbina; the Batangas part comes later.
